programs.property_linked: YES (RE qualifying — **INCLUDES real estate**, contrast with KZ which EXCLUDES RE)
programs.caveats: Per Presidential Decree UP-89 of April 2025 entered into force 1 June 2025; verify at evisa.gov.uz / mfa.uz

programs.min_threshold: None (EU/EEA, UK, CA, AU, NZ, JP, KR, IL, Türkiye, GCC, most LatAm + Asia)
programs.caveats: 2019/2020/2024 expansions; foreign-buyer DD trip feasible visa-free; verify at MFA
Online application via e-visa.gov.uz; introduced 15 July 2018
Decoupled from standard work permit; aligned with IT Park resident company sponsorship
Standard route; passive RE alone NOT a residence pathway pre-Golden-Visa

programs.min_threshold: £250k/yr minimum tax (post-14 Jul 2023); property £3.5m houses / £1.75m apartments (verify with Locate Jersey)
programs.property_linked: Yes — must purchase qualifying Jersey property
programs.pr_citizenship: Entitled status (2(1)(e)) granted on consent; no automatic citizenship route
programs.caveats: Pre-2018 consents grandfathered at £170k from 2023 (was £145k). PENDING P.19/2026 statutory cap proposes 15/yr / 75 per 5-yr period. Tax: 20% on first £1.25m non-Jersey income, then 1%. Mandatory independent taxation from 2026 (married couples incl. HVRs).

programs.min_threshold: Open Market property (~1,600 dwellings, no quota); £50k Document Duty trigger ≈ £1.06M PPR / £1.4M industry-typical; £60k annual Tax Cap; £160k / £320k worldwide caps
programs.property_linked: Yes — must purchase Open Market property
programs.pr_citizenship: Population Management ladder: 8yrs Established Resident → 14yrs Permanent Resident (10-of-20 retention)
programs.caveats: Standard Charge rises £40k (2024) → £50k from year-of-charge 2026 (P.2025-121). Alderney Cap split: legacy £65k (2024 only, withdrawn end-2025) vs new £60k Alderney Property Tax Cap from 1 Jan 2025. NO CGT/IHT/GST.

programs.min_threshold: £2M net worth (Hassans verbatim); £118k income cap; £37k minimum annual tax / £42,380 maximum
programs.property_linked: Yes — approved Gibraltar residence required (Open Market only; Cat-2 applicants pre-arrival are categorically Open Market)
programs.pr_citizenship: Renewable; NO direct PR/citizenship route from Cat-2 alone
programs.caveats: Qualifying (Category 2) Individuals Rules 2004 statutory basis. £1,168 application fee + £42,380 refundable deposit. 5-yr non-residency window required pre-application. Frontier Treaty (provisionally applied since 15 Jul 2026) does NOT override Cat-2 physical-presence test. Residence Criteria framework announced 17 Jun 2026 (HMGoG PR 466/2026 — regulations pending; Cat-2-specific changes unconfirmed at primary level).

programs.min_threshold: £160k earnings floor + £160k assessable cap; £39,940 fixed annual tax
programs.pr_citizenship: Renewable; NO direct PR/citizenship route from HEPSS alone
programs.caveats: HEPSS Rules 2008 statutory basis. 3-yr non-residency window required pre-application. Self-employment refusal caveat — Gibraltar restricts self-employed work permits for many non-EU nationals.

programs.min_threshold: Advisory tier only — verify at NIPDB / Ministry of Home Affairs (gov.na figures not anchored)
programs.pr_citizenship: 5-yr renewable residence permit; NOT instant PR or citizenship
programs.caveats: Launched Mar 2023 (run with Henley & Partners); thresholds advisory/aggregator-tier; NO citizenship-by-investment; property purchase confers NO residence right

programs.pr_citizenship: n/a — programme not operational as of Jun 2026
programs.caveats: Citizenship (Amendment) Bill 2025 passed Parliament 17 Dec 2025 (permits multiple citizenship); CBI announced but threshold/regulations not set. Investor/residence permits exist but thresholds are agency-sourced — verify at BITC / gov.bw

programs.programme: Citizenship by Investment — Development Support Programme (DSP / CIIP)
programs.min_threshold: ~USD 130,000 donation (single applicant; secondary — verify at Citizenship Office)
programs.property_linked: No (donation to the National Development Fund, NOT real estate)
programs.caveats: EU PERMANENTLY revoked Vanuatu's visa-free Schengen access 12 Dec 2024 (Reg (EU) 2025/11); sustained OECD/EU scrutiny. Buying property does NOT confer citizenship

programs.programme: NO formal RBI / CBI via real estate
programs.caveats: The Foreign Investment Act licence governs OWNERSHIP (acreage thresholds), NOT residency; buying property confers no immigration right

programs.min_threshold: Verify at Board of Investment / Ministry of Interior (LTR Digital Portal pending go-live)
programs.property_linked: No (LTR permits land acquisition / SEZ investment but is not an RE-purchase-pegged route)
programs.caveats: Framework government-approved ~Sept 2025 (secondary: Business Recorder / Radio Pakistan); digital portal not yet live. Diaspora buyers use POC / NICOP + the SBP Roshan Digital Account, NOT the LTR
